RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, November 11, 2010/Kartika 20, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Communications and
Information Technology; Culture; Earth Sciences; External
Affairs; Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation; Overseas
Indian Affairs; Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel,
Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning;
Science and Technology; Social Justice
and Empowerment; Space; Tourism;
Urban Development; Water
Resources; Y outh Affairs
and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
13
Steering group for economic
reforms
*41. SHRI DHIRAJ PRASAD SAHU:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
set up a steering group which would
monitor the implementation of economic
reforms proposed in the Plan document;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
its terms of reference;
(c) whether Government proposes to
implement some development schemes for
hundred most backward districts;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the strategy developed to supervise
the implementation of the scheme?
Panchayat Sanchar Sewa Yojana
*42. SHRI RAM KRIPAL Y ADAV:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether all villages in the country
have been covered under the Panchayat
Sanchar Sewa Yojana, specially in Bihar
State;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether any time-frame has been
fixed to achieve the target of this Scheme?

14
Strengthening of National
Commission for Scheduled Castes
*43. SHRIMA TI GUNDU
SUDHARANI: Will the Minister of
SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken by the Ministry for strengthening
the National Commission for Scheduled
Castes; and
(b) the reasons for not filling up the
post of Chairman of SC Commission in
spite of it remaining vacant for the last so
many months?
Metro rail in Jaipur
†*44. SHRI OM PRAKASH
MATHUR: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the required criteria and
sufficient number of passengers have been
ensured before starting metro rail project
in Jaipur;
(b) whether it has been decided as to
who would meet the expenditure on this
project and the basis therefor;
(c) whether this project has been divided
into phases; and
(d) if so, by when it is likely to be
completed?
Extradition of Warren Anderson
*45. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL  AFFAIRS be pleased to refer
to answer to Starred Question 63 given in
the Rajya Sabha on 29th July, 2010 and
state:
(a) the action taken so far after 18-21
June, 2010 for extradition of Warren
Anderson; and
(b) whether this issue has been included
in the agenda of discussions between
President of USA and Government of
India?
Funds for construction of flats
*46. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds allocated to the
Ministry for construction of flats in CWG
Games Village;
(b) the details of funds utilized/spent,
project-wise;
(c) the details of the private builders/
construction companies which were
awarded tenders for construction of flats
in Games Village, project-wise;
(d) whether all construction companies
handed over the flats to DDA/the Ministry
in time; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor along with the action
taken against those companies for creating
a mess and tarnishing the reputation of the
country?
Shortage of water in cities
*47. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN: Will
the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has made any
assessment of the actue shortage of water
in major metropolitan cities;
(b) if so, the steps to be taken in this
regard; and
(c) the action being taken in resolving
conflicts over inter-State rivers and their
contamination which are the major source
of water supply?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

15
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
India's rank in world hunger index
†*48. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India ranks
67th among the 85 nations of the world
particularly where hunger is in prevalence;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto;
(c) whether Government has conducted
any survey at its own level to ascertain the
number of people in India who could not
afford two square meals a day; and
(d) if so, the estimated number of such
people?
